scope: The observer identified the CLI's direct child with argv containing amu-program, SIGKILLed the CLI, then checked that same PID was non-zombie and still had that argv after 0.2 seconds. Earlier short-loop and argv-path attempts did not observe the guest; a separate unobserved run reached the CLI's 5-second timeout. This single local Mac observation does not test a lock, actual workload, grandchild, latest runtime, remote Mac mini, or governor. It does not establish how long the guest would otherwise survive. Python was used only as a one-off test observer.
